# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the start of the series; deceased four years later  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c31 P18](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0018), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030), [v1 c27 P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and lengthy iron-gray hair. He had warm brown eyes and wore a thick, gentle brown beard continuously from the age of twenty. When going away on important business, he wore fine clothes with a white collar.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Obed was extremely bashful, quiet, and reserved, avoiding unfamiliar people and rarely speaking on his own initiative. Beneath his timid and taciturn exterior, he was tender-hearted, patient, and good-natured. Though reasoning was not his strength, he possessed a quiet, persistent stubbornness once he made up his mind. He was a silent listener who enjoyed loquacious companions who led conversations without expecting his participation.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c14 P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

## Goals

- Providing a good home, upbringing, and education to Nell  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)</sub>

## History

Obed resided at Grey Shutters with his sister Thirza, running his farm located on the edge of Brierley. Seeking a young boy to assist with farm work due to his advancing age and failing heart, he traveled to Alder River to collect an orphan from Mrs. Alexander Tranter, only to discover that an orphan girl named Nell had been sent by mistake. Despite initial intentions to send her back, Obed grew fond of her and quietly insisted on retaining her. Over the following four years, he offered her unconditional affection, warmth, and quiet encouragement while leaving her strict discipline to Thirza. As his health declined, his heart spells grew more frequent, forcing him to refrain from strenuous work and excitement. He lived to see Nell excel academically and win the Avery scholarship, taking immense pride in her achievements. He passed away four years after bringing Nell home, leaving her and Thirza behind to cherish his memory.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Brierley by a father who was as bashful and quiet as himself  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Grew a thick, gentle brown beard at twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Suffered from worsening heart trouble in his old age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
- Owned a red and white spotted handkerchief  <sub>[v2 c20 P16](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0016)</sub>
